blurb:
Visit the incredible NASA Space Center Houston like a true Houston all-star with our NASA TRIPLE PLAY and get your Space Center admission tickets, round-trip transportation, & Mission Control tram tickets all in one convenient, budget-friendly bundle deal. 

Our 3-in-1 NASA TRIPLE PLAY bundle deal includes your Space Center general admission ticket, Mission Control tram (add-on tour) ticket, and Round-trip Transportation service on board our Mercedes Sprinter Shuttles from our Downtown Houston departure point to the iconic NASA Space Center which is a 45 - 60 minute ride from the center of Houston. 

Upon arrival to the gigantic Space Center Houston campus, enjoy the incredible Rocket Park and Saturn V rocket that changed the world! Board the replica 905 Space Shuttle as part of Independence Plaza. Learn what life is like at the International Space Station. See the possibilities of life on Mars. There is something for everyone of all ages at the Space Center!
